items.quote: Birks Building: Vancouver Centre Development Limited At the meeting of Council on February 5, 1974, it was agreed to hear delegations on the matter
items.why: One building's proposed demolition, still under deliberation and deferred.
items.summary: Council is weighing a Board of Administration report on Vancouver Centre Development Limited's proposed demolition of the Birks Building, deferred from February 5.

items.quote: Birks Building: Vancouver Centre Development Limited
items.why: One building's demolition and lease, deferred pending a report; controversial but limited to one site.
items.summary: Council deferred the Birks Building demolition matter pending a Board of Administration report, and authorized a special committee to meet Vancouver Centre Development Limited.

items.quote: MOVED by Aid. Hardwick, THAT the letter from the Minister of Transport and Communi-cations, dated February 5, 1974, be received and referred
items.why: Referral for a watching brief on a provincial inspection station's location.
items.summary: Council referred the provincial letter on the Alberni and Bidwell motor-vehicle inspection station to city engineers and planning for watching.

items.quote: MOVED by Aid. Linnell, THAT the Corporation Counsel be instructed to bring in an amendment to the Sunday Sports By-law No. 3711 to include wrestling.
items.why: Instructs drafting of a by-law change allowing Sunday wrestling; a proposal only.
items.summary: Council instructed the Corporation Counsel to amend the Sunday Sports By-law to permit professional wrestling on Sundays.

items.quote: THAT the recommendations of the Board of Administration contained in clauses 1, 2 and 3 of this report be approved.
items.why: Approves three routine works clauses: local improvement rates, sewer inspection, landfill cover.
items.summary: Council approved Board of Administration recommendations on local improvement flat rates, sewer TV inspection, and Delta Landfill cover material.

items.quote: Building and Planning Matters (February 15, 1974) The Council considered this report which contains four clauses
items.why: Clause 2 permits duplex alterations on one lot; clause 1 concerns the building board of appeal.
items.summary: Council approved Board of Administration recommendations on a building by-law board of appeal and alterations to a duplex at 3541 Point Grey Road.

items.quote: Strata Title Application: New Construction 2777 Oak Street (Clause 3)
items.why: Approves strata title for one new apartment building on a single site.
items.summary: Council approved Glenfield Holdings Ltd.'s strata title application for a new apartment development at 2777 Oak Street, subject to city by-laws.

items.quote: Strata Title Application: New Construction #680 East 5th Avenue (Clause 4)
items.why: Approves strata title for one new apartment building on a single site.
items.summary: Council approved Farmers & Merchants Trust Co. Ltd.'s strata title application for a new apartment development at 680 East 5th Avenue, subject to city by-laws.

items.quote: Fire and Traffic Matters (February 15, 1974) MOVED by Ald.Linnell, THAT the recommendation of the Board
items.why: Conversion of the citywide Fire Department radio system affects fire service operations.
items.summary: Council approved the Board of Administration recommendation to convert the Fire Department radio system.

items.quote: Finance Matters (February 15, 1974) This report of the Board of Administration contains seven clauses
items.why: A list of seven finance clauses whose outcome is not printed on this page.
items.summary: The Board of Administration's seven finance clauses, covering investments, marine insurance, tenders and grants, were before Council; outcomes continue on the next page.

items.quote: Investment Matters (Various Funds) December, 1973
items.why: Routine report on city investment funds with little public effect.
items.summary: Council approved the Board of Administration's December 1973 investment report on various city funds.

items.quote: Marine Insurance
items.why: Routine insurance matter for city property, little public effect.
items.summary: Council approved the Board of Administration's marine insurance clause for city property.

items.quote: Tender - Electric Lamps, Starters and Ballasts
items.why: Routine city equipment purchase tender with little public effect.
items.summary: Council approved the tender for electric lamps, starters and ballasts for the city.

items.quote: Request for Grant Equal to Taxes: Hospital Properties (Clause 4)
items.why: Tax-equivalent grants to two hospitals, a real benefit for each hospital.
items.summary: Council granted $4,960.02 to Holy Family Hospital and $7,065.83 to St. Vincent's Hospital in lieu of taxes.

items.quote: Theatre Rental: CKNW Orphans Fund (Clause 7)

money.purpose: toward rental of the Queen Elizabeth Theatre

items.why: A one-time grant for a charity fund's theatre rental.
items.summary: Council granted $400 to the CKNW Orphans Fund toward a $1,200 Queen Elizabeth Theatre rental.

items.quote: Acquisition for Park Site - 1139 Pendrell Street
items.why: Land acquired for a park site, a real change for one neighbourhood.
items.summary: Council approved acquiring 1139 Pendrell Street as a park site.

items.quote: Acquisition for Knight Street Widening 1392 East 28th Avenue
items.why: Property taken for a street widening affecting one address.
items.summary: Council approved acquiring 1392 East 28th Avenue for the Knight Street widening.

items.quote: Acquisition for Replotting and Future Boundary Road Widening, 4885 Boundary Road
items.why: Property taken for replotting and future road widening at one address.
items.summary: Council approved acquiring 4885 Boundary Road for replotting and future road widening.

items.quote: Paper Recycling Project: City Collection
items.why: Approves one more paper collection area, a local service change.
items.summary: Council approved the X-Kalay Foundation Society collecting paper from a fourth area in the City, with the location set by the City Engineer.

items.quote: Park Extensions, Strathcona (Clause 1)
items.why: Adds park land in Strathcona, a real change for that neighbourhood.
items.summary: Council approved the Director of Planning's recommendations to extend parks in Strathcona.

items.quote: Strathcona Linear Park (Clause 2)
items.why: Approves the linear park plan for Strathcona, a neighbourhood-scale change.
items.summary: Council approved the Director of Planning and City Engineer recommendations on the Strathcona Linear Park.

items.quote: Boat Shelter: 23 South Renfrew Stroet (Clause 3)
items.why: Only grants a delegation hearing on a single boat shelter.
items.summary: Council granted permission to hear a delegation on the boat shelter at 23 South Renfrew Street.

items.quote: Capilano Stadium: Future Uses (Cont'd.) Subsequent to the last meeting of the Sub-Committee the Board
items.department: Sub-Committee of the General Purposes Committee

parties.name: Capilano Development Committee of the Red Door

money.purpose: maximum City cost to operate Capilano Stadium during the trial period

items.why: City-owned stadium trial use for amateur sports, one facility.
items.summary: Council adopted committee recommendations to trial Park Board operation of Capilano Stadium for summer 2019, with joint usage studied.

items.quote: Y.M.C.A. Building at 2617 East Broadway: Use for Travelling Youth and Young Men
items.why: One building's summer emergency sleeping use, refused after objections.
items.summary: Council took no further action on the Y.M.C.A.'s request to use 2617 East Broadway for summer emergency sleeping for travelling youth.

items.quote: Report of Board of Administration (Building and Planning Matters) dated June 5, 1970 (Cont'd.) (vi) Balance of Building and Planning Matters
items.why: Procedural adoption of routine building and planning clauses; little individual impact.
items.summary: Council adopted Clauses 1, 2, 4, 5, 7 and 11 of the Board of Administration building and planning report and received Clause 10 for information.

items.quote: Social Assistance: I.W.A. Members The Council received a communication from the International Woodworkers of America advising members have been refused
items.why: Affects striking workers' access to unemployment insurance and social assistance, a defined group.
items.summary: Council asked the Acting Social Service Administrator to act on provincial directives and urged senior governments to grant aid to laid-off workers; Phillips's amendment lost.

items.quote: Claim of [name withheld] 3891 Arbutus Street
items.why: A single claimant's claim, deferred one week without decision.
items.summary: Council deferred consideration of [name withheld]'s claim concerning 3891 Arbutus Street for one week.

items.quote: Attendance at Calgary Exhibition and Stampede by the Vancouver Fire Department Band (Clause 3)
items.why: A band's trip to an exhibition, deferred one week; minor routine request.
items.summary: Council deferred the request for the Vancouver Fire Department Band to attend the Calgary Exhibition and Stampede for one week.

items.quote: MOVED by Aid. Linnell, THAT Clauses 1 and 2 of the Board of Administration report (Fire and Traffic matters) dated June 5, 1970
items.why: Adopts two clauses of a fire and traffic report; contents not printed here.
items.summary: Council adopted Clauses 1 and 2 of the Board of Administration report on fire and traffic matters dated June 5, 1970.

items.quote: The Canadian Council of Christians and Jews Inc. - Luncheon and Passes (Clause 1)

parties.name: The Canadian Council of Christians and Jews Inc.

items.why: A luncheon and passes request, deferred one week without decision.
items.summary: Council deferred the Canadian Council of Christians and Jews request for a luncheon and passes for one week.

items.quote: B.C. Highland Dancing Association (Clause 2)
items.why: A dancing association's request, held pending a delegation hearing.
items.summary: Council deferred the B.C. Highland Dancing Association's matter pending a hearing of a delegation.

items.quote: The Playhouse Theatre Company Booth - City Hall (Clause 3)
items.why: A one-week promotional booth in City Hall; request lost, so little change.
items.summary: Council refused the Playhouse Theatre Company's request to place a promotional booth in City Hall for one week.

items.quote: B.C. Civil Liberties Association - Grant (Clause 5)
items.why: A grant request held pending a delegation hearing; no decision yet.
items.summary: Council deferred the B.C. Civil Liberties Association's grant request pending a hearing of a delegation.
